_readme: Homepage signal taxonomy. Each tag is detected by a keyword heuristic run against the page title, meta description, headings, and full visible body text captured from hero down to footer. Keyword matching is intentionally simple (no scraping API key needed) — treat matches as a first draft, not ground truth; the dashboard lets you override a capture's tags manually.

tags.label: Sale / Promo
tags.description: Sitewide discount, sale, or time-limited offer messaging

tags.label: New-In
tags.description: New arrivals / just landed called out on the homepage

tags.label: Gifting
tags.description: Gift-led messaging, gift guides or gift cards on the homepage

tags.label: Social Proof
tags.description: Reviews, ratings, press mentions or UGC surfaced on the homepage

tags.label: Loyalty / Rewards
tags.description: Membership, rewards or loyalty programme CTA

tags.label: Free Shipping / Returns
tags.description: Free delivery, free returns or shipping threshold banner

tags.label: Editorial / Storytelling
tags.description: Brand story, journal, campaign or 'meet the maker' style content
